title: Refund Policy
content: Customers can request a full refund within 7 days of purchase. After 7 days, we offer store credit only. To initiate a refund, email support@company.com with your order number.

title: Shipping Information
content: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days. All orders over $50 qualify for free standard shipping. Tracking information is emailed when your order ships.

title: Product Warranty
content: All products come with a 1-year manufacturer warranty. This covers defects in materials and workmanship. Damage from misuse is not covered. Contact support with photos of the defect to initiate a warranty claim.

title: Account & Login Help
content: To reset your password, click 'Forgot Password' on the login page. A reset link will be sent to your registered email. If you no longer have access to that email, contact support@company.com with your name and order history.

title: Contact & Support Hours
content: Our support team is available Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM EST. Email support@company.com or call 1-800-555-0100. Average email response time is 4 hours during business hours.
